description: Capability for the main window. Carries no filesystem scope on purpose: the only frontend fs consumer is MatugenSkill's readFile on a dialog-picked path, and tauri-plugin-dialog grants that exact path at runtime (allow_file), which tauri-plugin-fs honours independently of any static scope. Everything else reaches the filesystem through this app's own commands, which are not ACL-gated, or through the asset: handler, which is gated by PreviewGrants.
